projects.name: Lantify
projects.summary: Counter-Strike 2 statistics platform for LAN parties.
projects.description: A full-stack platform that processes Counter-Strike 2 match data and turns it into player rankings, statistics, match histories, and interactive visualizations for LAN parties.

projects.name: DLA Fractal CUDA
projects.description: A parallel implementation of Diffusion-Limited Aggregation using C++ and CUDA to generate coral-like fractals and evaluate GPU acceleration against a sequential CPU implementation. Developed as an undergraduate thesis and presented at ERAD/RS 2026.

projects.name: WirePenguin
projects.summary: Simple packet sniffer with a cool TUI.
projects.description: A simple network packet analyzer written in Rust with real-time packet capture, protocol inspection, dynamic statistics, and an interactive terminal interface. Supports Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6, ARP, ICMP, TCP, and UDP.

projects.name: vLLM Parallelism Benchmark
projects.summary: Performance analysis of distributed LLM inference across multiple GPUs.
projects.description: An experimental study comparing Tensor Parallelism and Pipeline Parallelism for distributed LLM inference with vLLM and Ray. The project analyzes throughput, TTFT, ITL, GPU utilization, network traffic, and communication overhead across multi-GPU cluster configurations.

projects.name: Asteroid Way
projects.summary: Asteroids Game made in x86 assembly.
projects.description: A complete game developed in 8086 Assembly featuring asteroid collisions, projectiles, power-ups, a HUD, timers, and five progressively harder stages. The project explores direct video memory manipulation, BIOS and DOS interrupts, and low-level game logic.
